name: IEC capacitive proximity sensor: normally open 3 wire
aliases: capacitive proximity sensor Normally Open 3 Wire
summary: Capacitive proximity sensor form: Normally Open 3 Wire.
description: A capacitive proximity sensor detects a change of capacitance caused by a target entering its sensing field. This entry identifies the normally open 3 wire form in the publisher's IEC-context family.

A vessel wall or nearby material can change the measured capacitance and indicate a level or presence condition. The normally-open designation starts with a non-conducting output or open contact in the documented reference condition; operation changes that state. The three-wire form distinguishes supply, return and switching output. Confirm sourcing or sinking operation from the actual sensor circuit before connecting it to an input.
Material, mounting, contamination and adjustment affect operation; a capacitive mark does not guarantee detection through every container or medium.
